status: Final metadata embedded in all 84 AVIF images; readback and validation passed.

classification.trainedAlgorithmicMedia: Underlying artwork was generated with a trained generative model. A corrected AI-generated full figure remains in this class; ordinary scaling, alpha padding or solid background flattening do not change its origin.
classification.compositeSynthetic: Composition of AI-generated artwork with other layout, backgrounds, typography, labels or optical marks. This includes the app tile, color logo lockups and all three proof sheets.
classification.compositeWithTrainedAlgorithmicMedia: Current IPTC meaning is generative editing or augmentation. Not used simply because a composite contains AI artwork.
classification.omitted_for_code_assisted: Existing SVG geometry or outlined typography was rasterized in an AI-assisted workflow. Its precise generative authorship is not established. Do not allow the builder digitalCapture fallback to remain.

important_distinctions: png/icons/head-small.png is a 64 px optical simplification; png/icons/sizes/nevrotick-64.png is a raster portrait resampling. Their DigitalSourceType treatments differ intentionally.
Stacked and illustrated logos include the tagline even though their filenames do not contain tagline.
For-dark PNG sources preserve transparency; the suffix is intended display context, not an embedded dark background.
Light monochrome artwork uses light ink; dark monochrome artwork uses dark ink.
App tile includes its rounded slate panel as part of the artwork while retaining transparent outer corners/margins in transparent variants.
Creator contact city/country are not image geolocation.
New UUIDs in image_guid identify the AVIF asset record; they are not inherited original-document IDs or cryptographic provenance.
Per-file descriptions are based on existing verified source manifests, review notes and supplied construction code. This step does not claim a fresh visual review or embedded metadata validation.
Stored source hashes are copied from the reviewed source manifest and must be compared by the final conversion/verification process; they were not recomputed during JSON preparation.
Raw generation prompts, prompt writer, model version, unrelated personal identifiers and camera/capture fields are intentionally absent.
Proprietary metadata expresses the user-selected terms for the brand assets. Existing third-party font notices remain separate and must not be replaced or erased.
